title: Six IPOs get aggressive bids worth ₹1.4 lakh crore as Rentomojo, Karamtara, LCC Projects sparkle
text: Six IPOs get aggressive bids worth ₹1.4 lakh crore as Rentomojo, Karamtara, LCC Projects sparkle. Rentomojo, Karamtara Engineering and LCC Projects were the biggest draws, while Steamhouse India and Arcil saw a modest response
